name: Equipment status code
description: Code specifying the status of equipment.

values.name: Continental
values.description: Continental The equipment is or will be moving across a continent on an intermodal or multimodal basis.

values.name: Export
values.description: Export Transport equipment to be exported on a marine vessel.

values.name: Import
values.description: Import Transport equipment to be imported on a marine vessel.

values.name: Remain on board
values.description: Remain on board Transport equipment arriving on a marine vessel is to remain on board.

values.name: Shifter
values.description: Shifter Transport equipment is to be shifted from one stowage location on a marine vessel to another on the same vessel.

values.name: Transhipment
values.description: Transhipment Transport equipment is to be transferred from one marine vessel to another.

values.name: Shortlanded
values.description: Shortlanded Transport equipment notified to arrive which did not arrive on the means of transport.

values.name: Overlanded
values.description: Overlanded Transport equipment not notified to arrive but which did arrive on the means of transport.

values.name: Domestic
values.description: Domestic Transport equipment is used in domestic service.

values.name: Positioning
values.description: Positioning Equipment is being transported for positioning purposes.

values.name: Delivery
values.description: Delivery Equipment is being delivered.

values.name: Redelivery
values.description: Redelivery Equipment is being redelivered.

values.name: Repair
values.description: Repair The equipment is for repair.

values.name: Reloader
values.description: Reloader Transport equipment to be discharged and subsequently reloaded on the same means of transport but in a different stowage location.

values.name: Returned
values.description: Returned The equipment is returned.

values.name: Dropped off
values.description: Dropped off The equipment is dropped off.

values.name: Cross terminal transshipment
values.description: Cross terminal transshipment The transport equipment that is unloaded will be loaded in another vessel at another terminal in the same port.

values.name: Booking confirmed
values.description: Booking confirmed Notification of the confirmation of booking of a transport equipment.

values.name: Inspected at terminal gate
values.description: Inspected at terminal gate Notification that a transport equipment has undergone a terminal gate inspection.

values.name: Arrived at offloading location
values.description: Arrived at offloading location Notification that a transport equipment arrived at the offloading location.

values.name: Departed from loading location.
values.description: Departed from loading location. Notification that a transport equipment departed from the loading location.

values.name: Loaded
values.description: Loaded Notification that a transport equipment has been loaded.

values.name: Unloaded
values.description: Unloaded Notification that a transport equipment has been unloaded.

values.name: Intra-terminal movement
values.description: Intra-terminal movement Notification that a transport equipment has been subject to an intra-terminal movement.

values.name: Stuffing ordered
values.description: Stuffing ordered Notification that a transport equipment has been ordered to be stuffed.

values.name: Stripping ordered
values.description: Stripping ordered Notification that a transport equipment has been ordered to be stripped.

values.name: Stuffing confirmed
values.description: Stuffing confirmed Notification that a transport equipment has been confirmed as stuffed.

values.name: Stripping confirmed
values.description: Stripping confirmed Notification that a transport equipment has been confirmed as stripped.

values.name: Sent for heavy repair
values.description: Sent for heavy repair Notification that a transport equipment has been sent for heavy repair.
